correctness.rationale: Uniform CRT proof reconstructed: the three prime classes cover pq+pr+qr-p-q-r+1 residues; each pair-divisor class meets its omitted prime class in exactly one residue and can add at most r-1, q-1, p-1, respectively; the final full-modulus class adds at most one. The seven explicit CRT coordinate assignments attain all three pair caps simultaneously, as the pair classes are pairwise disjoint and their common-prime coordinates are nonzero; the final point lies outside. The proof covers all p<q<r odd primes, with valid 0,1,2 residues. Exact independent finite checks in verify.py corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Öztürk explicitly publishes the exact identity as an unproved conjecture, rather than theorem. The new proof is uniformly valid and directly settles it by counting the mandatory single-point intersection of every two-prime class with its omitted-prime class and supplying a simultaneous sharp CRT witness. Unindexed independent prior solutions cannot be ruled out.
